name: quanthea
description: Describe a dashboard in a chat, an agent builds it against your data sources, pin the good ones.

scripts.check:package: bun packages/plugin-kit/scripts/dist.ts && publint packages/plugin-kit/dist && attw --pack packages/plugin-kit/dist --profile esm-only --format table-flipped --no-emoji --no-summary && bun packages/plugin-kit/scripts/consumer.ts
scripts.arch:graph: depcruise apps packages --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only '^(apps|packages)' --output-type dot | dot -T svg > dependency-graph.svg
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run docs:check && bun run arch && bun run knip && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run check:package
scripts.env:up: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres prometheus
scripts.env:up:timescale: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile timescale up -d --wait timescaledb
scripts.env:up:mysql: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile mysql up -d --wait mysql mariadb
scripts.env:up:clickhouse: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile clickhouse up -d --wait clickhouse
scripts.env:up:trino: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile trino up -d --wait trino
scripts.env:up:search: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile search up -d --wait elasticsearch opensearch && docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile search run --rm search-seed
scripts.env:up:influxdb: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile influxdb up -d --wait influxdb && docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile influxdb run --rm influxdb-seed
scripts.env:up:valkey: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile valkey up -d --wait valkey && docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile valkey run --rm valkey-seed
scripts.env:up:mongodb: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile mongodb up -d --wait mongodb && docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile mongodb run --rm -T mongodb-seed | docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile mongodb exec -T mongodb sh -c 'cat > /tmp/seed.js && mongosh --quiet --file /tmp/seed.js mongodb://quanthea_admin:quanthea-dev@127.0.0.1:27017/admin'
scripts.env:up:http: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile http up -d --wait http-api
scripts.env:up:loki: docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile loki up -d loki && docker compose -f dev/docker-compose.yml --profile loki run --rm loki-seed

author: Josep Boix Requesens
